blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Overseas Filipino Worker (OFW) Mary Jane Veloso is finally free after she has been released from the Correctional Institution for Women (CIW) in Mandaluyong City. This event comes following an absolute pardon granted by President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. Veloso walked out of the facility with full civil and political rights, completely extinguishing the legal liabilities stemming from her 2010 arrest. Her 16-year ordeal began when she was arrested at Adisucipto International Airport in Yogyakarta, Indonesia, after 2.6 kilograms of heroin were discovered hidden in the lining of her luggage.
